title: Baked Macaroni Cheese
summary: A classic American baked pasta dish with a creamy cheese sauce and a golden, bubbling top. Comforting and rich, it works well for a weeknight dinner or a cosy weekend meal.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cook the pasta in salted water until just al dente, then drain well.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until it smells slightly nutty.
Gradually whisk in the milk, a little at a time, until smooth. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens and coats the spoon.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in most of the cheddar, all of the parmesan, the mustard, salt, black pepper and nutmeg until smooth.
Mix the drained pasta into the cheese sauce, then spoon into a baking dish.
Toss the breadcrumbs with the olive oil and the remaining cheddar, then scatter over the top.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
